title: Béchamel
desc: A smooth milk sauce for gratins, lasagne and cheese sauces.
steps: Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over medium-low heat.
Stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes without browning.
Whisk in the milk gradually until smooth. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring constantly.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often. Add salt, white pepper and nutmeg.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Mornay
desc: Béchamel enriched with Gruyère and Parmesan.
steps: Warm the prepared béchamel gently in a saucepan, stirring.
Remove from the heat and stir in Gruyère and Parmesan until melted.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm; avoid boiling after adding the cheese.

title: Mustard Béchamel
desc: A mild mustard sauce built on béchamel.
steps: Warm the prepared béchamel gently in a saucepan, stirring.
Whisk in the Dijon mustard until evenly mixed.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Warm through gently and serve with vegetables or cooked meat.

title: Parsley Sauce
desc: Creamy parsley sauce with a little lemon.
steps: Warm the prepared béchamel gently in a saucepan, stirring.
Stir in the parsley and lemon juice off the heat.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve straight away with fish, potatoes or vegetables.

title: Soubise
desc: Soft onions blended into a smooth béchamel sauce.
steps: Melt butter in a covered saucepan over low heat.
Add onion, cover and cook gently for 25 minutes until very soft, stirring often and avoiding colour.
Stir in prepared béchamel and warm through. Blend until smooth.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Cheddar Sauce
desc: A smooth cheese sauce for vegetables, pasta and baked potatoes.
steps: Warm the prepared béchamel gently in a saucepan, stirring.
Take off the heat and stir in Cheddar until melted and smooth.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm; avoid boiling after adding the cheese.

title: Cream Sauce
desc: Béchamel finished with cream.
steps: Warm the prepared béchamel gently in a saucepan, stirring.
Whisk in the cream and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm, stirring before pouring.

title: Espagnole
desc: Brown stock thickened with a brown roux and aromatic vegetables.
steps: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan. Brown onion, carrot and celery over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add flour and stir until nut-brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in tomato paste for 1 minute.
Whisk in the prepared brown beef stock gradually. Add bay and thyme.
Simmer gently for 45 minutes, stirring and skimming. Strain through a fine sieve.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Demi-glace
desc: Espagnole and brown stock reduced to a concentrated sauce.
steps: Combine the prepared Espagnole and brown beef stock in a wide saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and skim the surface.
Reduce uncovered by about half, stirring occasionally; allow 45–60 minutes.
Strain, then check the displayed yield; reduce further or loosen with water as needed.

title: Bordelaise
desc: A rich brown sauce with red wine.
steps: Simmer red wine, shallot, thyme and bay in a small pan until reduced by two-thirds, about 10 minutes.
Stir in prepared demi-glace and simmer for 5 minutes, then strain.
Add marrow and simmer gently for 5 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Marchand de Vin
desc: Red wine and shallots enrich demi-glace.
steps: Simmer red wine and shallot until reduced by two-thirds, about 10 minutes.
Add prepared demi-glace and simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain, take off the heat and whisk in cold butter.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Madeira Sauce
desc: Demi-glace with the mellow flavour of Madeira.
steps: Simmer Madeira in a saucepan until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add prepared demi-glace and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and whisk in the butter.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Chasseur
desc: A brown sauce with mushrooms and herbs.
steps: Heat butter and fry the mushrooms for 6 minutes until browned.
Add shallot and cook for 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce by half.
Stir in tomato paste and prepared demi-glace; simmer for 5 minutes. Add tarragon.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Brown Mushroom Sauce
desc: Mushrooms in a rich brown sauce.
steps: Fry mushrooms in butter over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until browned.
Add shallot and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in prepared demi-glace and simmer for 5 minutes. Finish with parsley.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Peppercorn Sauce
desc: Creamy green peppercorn sauce with brandy.
steps: Soften shallot in butter for 3 minutes.
Take the pan away from the flame before adding brandy. Return to low heat and simmer for 2 minutes; do not ignite.
Add peppercorns, prepared demi-glace and cream. Simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Robert Sauce
desc: An onion and mustard brown sauce.
steps: Cook onion in butter over low heat for 10 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Add wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in prepared demi-glace and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in mustard.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Chicken Velouté
desc: A smooth sauce made with white chicken stock.
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes until pale gold.
Gradually whisk in the required prepared stock until smooth.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring often; add salt and white pepper.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Veal Velouté
desc: A delicate sauce made with white veal stock.
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes until pale gold.
Gradually whisk in the required prepared stock until smooth.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring often; add salt and white pepper.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Fish Velouté
desc: A light roux sauce made with fish fumet.
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes until pale gold.
Gradually whisk in the required prepared stock until smooth.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring often; add salt and white pepper.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Suprême Sauce
desc: Chicken velouté enriched with cream.
steps: Warm the prepared chicken velouté in a saucepan.
Add cream and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in butter and lemon juice.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Allemande
desc: Veal velouté enriched with egg yolks.
steps: Warm the prepared veal velouté until steaming, then lower the heat.
Whisk yolks and cream in a bowl. Gradually whisk in a ladle of hot sauce, then stir the mixture back into the pan.
Stir over low heat until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes; do not boil. Add lemon juice.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Normandy Sauce
desc: Creamy fish velouté with mushrooms.
steps: Soften mushrooms in butter for 5 minutes without browning.
Add prepared fish velouté and fish fumet. Simmer for 10 minutes, then strain.
Whisk yolks and cream in a bowl. Gradually whisk in a ladle of hot sauce, then stir the mixture back into the pan.
Stir over low heat until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes; do not boil. Add lemon juice.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: White Wine Sauce
desc: A creamy white wine sauce for fish.
steps: Simmer white wine and shallot until reduced by two-thirds, about 8 minutes.
Stir in prepared fish velouté and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cream, warm gently and strain.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Mushroom Velouté
desc: Chicken velouté with sautéed mushrooms.
steps: Fry mushrooms in butter for 8 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Stir in prepared chicken velouté and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cream and blend until smooth.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Hollandaise
desc: A warm butter emulsion made with pasteurised yolks and lemon.
steps: Melt the butter gently and keep it warm, not sizzling.
Whisk pasteurised yolks, lemon juice and measured water in a heatproof bowl over barely simmering water; the bowl must not touch the water.
Whisk for 3–5 minutes until thick enough to leave a trail, then remove from the heat.
Whisk in the warm butter very slowly, a little at a time, until glossy. Add salt and cayenne.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; keep the sauce warm, never hot, and do not boil.

title: Béarnaise
desc: A practical hollandaise-based béarnaise with shallot and tarragon reduction.
steps: Simmer wine, vinegar and shallot with half the tarragon and the pepper until almost dry, about 8 minutes.
Cool the reduction until lukewarm; finely chop any remaining large pieces.
Fold the reduction and remaining tarragon into the prepared hollandaise.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; keep the sauce warm, never hot, and do not boil.

title: Choron
desc: Béarnaise with a touch of tomato.
steps: Cook tomato paste in butter over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring.
Let the tomato mixture cool until lukewarm.
Fold into the prepared béarnaise until evenly coloured.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; keep the sauce warm, never hot, and do not boil.

title: Foyot
desc: Béarnaise enriched with meat glaze.
steps: Warm the prepared meat glaze gently until fluid.
Let it cool until lukewarm so it will not split the béarnaise.
Fold the glaze into the prepared béarnaise a little at a time.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; keep the sauce warm, never hot, and do not boil.

title: Mousseline
desc: Hollandaise lightened with softly whipped cream.
steps: Whip the cold cream to soft peaks.
Let the prepared hollandaise become lukewarm rather than hot.
Fold the whipped cream into the hollandaise gently, keeping as much air as possible.
Serve immediately over cooked vegetables or fish; do not reheat.

title: Maltaise
desc: Hollandaise with orange juice and zest.
steps: Simmer blood orange juice until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the zest and cool until lukewarm.
Whisk into the prepared hollandaise a little at a time.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; keep the sauce warm, never hot, and do not boil.

title: Dijon Hollandaise
desc: Hollandaise sharpened with Dijon mustard.
steps: Place prepared hollandaise in a warm bowl, away from direct heat.
Whisk in Dijon mustard until smooth.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; keep the sauce warm, never hot, and do not boil.

title: Mayonnaise
desc: A cold oil emulsion made with pasteurised yolks.
steps: Whisk pasteurised yolks, mustard, lemon juice, vinegar and salt in a bowl.
Add oil drop by drop while whisking until the mixture starts to thicken.
Continue adding oil in a thin stream, whisking constantly until thick and glossy.
Measure and whisk in cold water to reach the displayed yield. Cover and refrigerate; use within 2 days.

title: Garlic Aioli
desc: A quick garlic mayonnaise.
steps: Mash garlic with the lemon juice until fine.
Stir the garlic mixture into prepared mayonnaise.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Tartare Sauce
desc: A tangy mayonnaise sauce for fish.
steps: Drain the gherkins and capers well; chop the parsley finely.
Fold gherkins, capers, parsley and lemon juice into prepared mayonnaise.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Remoulade
desc: Mustard and herbs enrich this cold sauce.
steps: Drain the gherkins and capers; finely chop the herbs.
Stir gherkins, capers, mustard, tarragon and parsley into prepared mayonnaise.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Marie Rose Sauce
desc: A creamy cocktail sauce for seafood.
steps: Mix ketchup, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and cayenne in a bowl.
Fold the ketchup mixture into prepared mayonnaise until pale pink.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Thousand Island Dressing
desc: A creamy dressing with chopped pickles.
steps: Mix ketchup, drained gherkins, onion and lemon juice.
Stir the mixture into prepared mayonnaise.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Herb Mayonnaise
desc: Fresh herbs folded into mayonnaise.
steps: Chop parsley, chives and dill finely.
Fold the herbs and lemon juice into prepared mayonnaise.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Sriracha Mayonnaise
desc: A creamy chilli sauce for dipping.
steps: Mix sriracha and lemon juice in a bowl.
Stir in prepared mayonnaise until evenly coloured.
Measure the sauce and stir in cold water as needed to reach the displayed yield.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving; use within 2 days.

title: Foundation Tomato Sauce
desc: A simple tomato base for pasta sauces, braises and bakes.
steps: Soften onion in olive oil over medium-low heat for 8 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato paste; cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend until smooth, taking care with the hot liquid.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Marinara
desc: A simple garlic and herb tomato sauce.
steps: Warm garlic in olive oil over low heat for 1 minute without browning.
Add prepared tomato sauce and oregano; simmer for 10 minutes.
Tear the basil leaves and stir into the sauce off the heat.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Arrabbiata
desc: A fiery tomato sauce with garlic and chilli.
steps: Warm oil in a saucepan over low heat.
Add garlic and chilli flakes; stir for 1 minute without browning.
Stir in prepared tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes. Add parsley.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Puttanesca
desc: Tomato sauce with olives, capers and anchovies.
steps: Warm oil and garlic in a saucepan for 1 minute.
Add anchovies and chilli; stir until the anchovies break down.
Add olives, capers and prepared tomato sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Tomato Basil Sauce
desc: Tomato sauce finished with fresh basil.
steps: Warm prepared tomato sauce gently for 5 minutes.
Tear or chop the basil leaves just before using.
Take the sauce off the heat and stir in basil and olive oil.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Vodka Tomato Cream Sauce
desc: A smooth tomato cream sauce with vodka.
steps: Soften shallot in butter for 3 minutes.
Remove the pan from the flame, add vodka, then return to low heat and simmer for 2 minutes without igniting.
Add prepared tomato sauce and cream. Simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Provençale Tomato Sauce
desc: Tomato sauce with vegetables and olives.
steps: Soften the red pepper in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add garlic and oregano; stir for 1 minute.
Add olives and prepared tomato sauce; simmer for 10 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Beurre Blanc
desc: A warm white-wine and butter emulsion for fish and vegetables.
steps: Simmer wine, vinegar and shallot until only a little syrupy liquid remains, about 10 minutes.
Cut the cold butter into cubes. Lower the heat to its minimum.
Whisk butter into the reduction a few cubes at a time, lifting the pan off the heat if needed; never boil.
Add salt, strain and whisk in warm water to the displayed yield. Serve immediately.

title: Herb Beurre Blanc
desc: White wine butter sauce with fresh herbs.
steps: Put prepared beurre blanc in a warm bowl away from direct heat.
Fold the chives and parsley into the warm sauce.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; reheating or boiling can split the sauce.

title: Citrus Beurre Blanc
desc: A bright citrus variation of beurre blanc.
steps: Put prepared beurre blanc in a warm bowl away from direct heat.
Whisk in lemon and blood orange juices a little at a time.
Measure the sauce; loosen with hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve immediately; reheating or boiling can split the sauce.

title: Brown Butter
desc: Nutty browned butter; the finished weight varies with water loss.
steps: Cut the butter into even pieces and place in a light-coloured saucepan.
Melt over medium heat, swirling the pan as the butter foams.
Cook for 5–8 minutes until the milk solids turn golden brown and smell nutty; watch closely near the end.
Immediately pour into a heatproof bowl, including the brown specks. Weigh out the displayed yield and reserve any extra.

title: Garlic Butter
desc: Soft butter mixed with garlic, parsley and salt.
steps: Let the butter soften until spreadable, without melting.
Mash in the garlic, parsley and salt evenly.
Spoon into a covered container or roll in baking paper.
Refrigerate until firm; use within 3 days or freeze in portions.

title: Café de Paris-Style Butter
desc: A savoury herb butter for grilled meat.
steps: Soften butter at room temperature until spreadable.
Mash shallot, garlic, mustard, lemon juice and anchovies into a fine paste.
Mix the paste into the butter with parsley, tarragon, curry powder and Worcestershire sauce.
Roll in baking paper and chill until firm. Use within 3 days or freeze in slices.

title: Basic Pan Sauce
desc: A sauce made in the pan used to cook meat, using its browned juices.
steps: Use a clean saucepan, or a pan with browned cooking juices if available. Add any optional defatted roasting juices; discard burnt residue.
Add butter and shallot; soften for 2 minutes.
Pour in wine and scrape up browned juices. Simmer until reduced by half.
Add prepared brown chicken stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.

title: Red-Wine Pan Sauce
desc: A glossy pan sauce with red wine.
steps: Reduce red wine by half in a small saucepan, about 5 minutes.
Stir in prepared pan sauce and simmer for 3 minutes; take off the heat and whisk in butter.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm, stirring before pouring.

title: Brandy Cream Sauce
desc: A creamy pan sauce with brandy.
steps: Add brandy to a small pan away from the flame, then simmer gently for 2 minutes without igniting.
Add prepared pan sauce and cream; simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm, stirring before pouring.

title: Mustard Cream Sauce
desc: A creamy mustard sauce for meat.
steps: Warm prepared pan sauce with cream for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and whisk in Dijon mustard.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm, stirring before pouring.

title: Mushroom Pan Sauce
desc: A quick pan sauce with sautéed mushrooms.
steps: Fry mushrooms in butter for 8 minutes until browned.
Add prepared pan sauce and cream; simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Measure the sauce; simmer to reduce or stir in hot water to reach the displayed yield.
Serve warm, stirring before pouring.
